snippet.description:
Vox’s Astead Herndon sat down with Sen. Raphael Warnock, who reflected on balancing his duties as a US Senator with preaching at Atlanta’s historic Ebenezer Baptist Church — and why serving in D.C. gives him more sermon material than ever.

Watch the full episode of America, Actually here on YouTube, or listen wherever you get your podcasts.

Subscribe to our channel and turn on notifications (🔔) so you don't miss any videos: http://goo.gl/0bsAjO
